stdout:
Transition a durable live chat event. Use this tool to change the status of a live chat message (e.g., close a poll).

Usage:
  yutu liveChatMessage transition [flags]

Examples:
# Transition a live chat message to closed
yutu liveChatMessage transition --ids abc123 --status closed

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for transition
  -i, --ids strings     IDs of the messages to transition
  -o, --output string   json|yaml|silent
  -s, --status string   Status to transition to (closed)
      --yes             Confirm the operation
